title: Accelerated model request funnel with eval gates for enterprise onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers and Solutions teams submit ad-hoc requests to add new models, pin versions, or request deprecations without consistent evaluation or risk signals. This causes unpredictable catalog churn, undocumented pin reasons, missed regression risks, and engineering load for one-off pins.

Goal: Define and implement a staged intake funnel + triage rubric that routes requests into the right lane (sandbox, standard catalog, enterprise-gated, compliance) and enforces minimal eval and cost signals before changes hit hosted/dedicated/private catalogs. Reduce engineering ad-hoc work by 60% for pin/deprecation requests and standardize audit trail for enterprise SLAs.

Outcomes:
- A public intake form (Console + API) capturing SLA needs, data residency, quantization requirement, expected QPS, golden prompts, and regression risk level.
- A triage rubric that assigns to lanes and mandates smoke-eval thresholds before approval.
- Automation: tags, tickets, and templated PRs for model onboarding; enforcement of pin/deprecation TTLs and audit logs.
- Pilot with 3 enterprise customers before full rollout.

Scope: model additions, variant pinning, deprecations, and gated onboarding for enterprise/private deployments. Excludes bug fixes to runtime or infra capacity planning (handled in ENG backlog).

Non-goals: solving long-term model stewardship policy; initial focus is process + checkpoints + minimal automation.
